summary: {clerk} asks whether the promise of an old job back also applies if it is the clerk who wants to leave.
realLife: Swanson recalled Rayburn offering him a trial month as assistant reading clerk and promising him a way back. Swanson asked to keep that choice for himself as well.
inGame: needs: the appointment terms and the previous position.

turns.pulledBy: The old office agrees to hold the position.
turns.what: The applicant tries the reading desk.
turns.writesBack: The appointment carries a review date.

turns.pulledBy: The old position must be filled now.
